paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.79% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (-0.22%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.47%). Brent crude changed +2.15% to 102.35. Gold changed +0.40% to 4,157.2002. Bitcoin changed -3.68% to 82,413.3125. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.15%. Among the firms tracked, Deutsche Bank (-4.50%) and HSBC (-3.97%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger (BBC Business). The merger of two of Hollywood's biggest movie studios comes after months of legal disputes and concern over competition. Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Central banks and macro: US oil trader takes $2bn gamble on tankers as carriers steer clear of Hormuz (FT Markets). American security push aims to spur Asian refining as diesel shortages stoke inflation Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors look beyond Middle East war in pursuit of region’s vast reserves (FT World). Western groups look to new investment opportunities despite the chaos and heightened risks caused by the conflict with Iran
